title: Parser-Free VLM Verification for Federated Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.07455v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How can vision-language models help video anomaly detection (VAD) when surveillance data remain distributed, weakly labeled, and resource-constrained? Most weakly supervised VAD methods assume centralized training; recent VLM-based extensions further rely on dense inference, generated explanations, or additional adaptation. We introduce a lightweight federated MIL-VLM cascade in which only a compact MIL scorer is trained across clients, while a frozen VLM verifies high-scoring suspect segments post hoc. We study two VLM feedback interfaces: parsed text-generation decisions and a logit-based interface that extracts a continuous anomaly score from next-token Yes/No probabilities. Experiments on UCF-Crime with InternVL3.5-2B and Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct show that text-generation verification can improve frame-level AUC after diagnostic temporal post-processing, but remains sensitive to prompts, parsers, model choice, and smoothing. translated_title: 面向联邦弱监督视频异常检测的无解析器VLM验证
translated_abstract: 当监控数据仍然处于分布式、弱标注且资源受限的状态时，视觉语言模型（VLM）如何助力视频异常检测（VAD）？大多数弱监督VAD方法假设集中式训练；而近期基于VLM的扩展方法则进一步依赖密集推理、生成的解释或额外的适配训练。我们提出了一种轻量级的联邦MIL-VLM级联架构，其中仅在客户端之间训练一个紧凑的MIL评分器，而冻结的VLM则在事后对高分可疑片段进行验证。我们研究了两种VLM反馈接口：解析文本生成决策的接口，以及从下一个token的Yes/No概率中提取连续异常分数的基于logit的接口。在UCF-Crime数据集上使用InternVL3.5-2B和Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct进行的实验表明，文本生成验证在经过诊断性时序后处理后可以提升帧级AUC，但对提示词、解析器、模型选择和平滑处理仍然敏感。相比之下（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出一种轻量级联邦MIL-VLM级联方法，仅在客户端训练紧凑的MIL评分器并利用冻结VLM事后验证可疑片段，其中基于logit的无解析器接口相比文本生成验证能更稳定地提升弱监督视频异常检测性能。
en_tdlr: A lightweight federated MIL-VLM cascade trains only a compact MIL scorer across clients while a frozen VLM verifies high-scoring suspect segments post hoc, with a parser-free logit-based interface providing more stable verification than text generation for weakly supervised video anomaly detection.
